spec_match.rationale: Implements CSS Values 5 forced normalisation and the CSS Color 5 §3.3 fold in JS and compares against the browser.

interactive.rationale: Add/remove rows (1-6), per-row colour and optional percentage, space select.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index blurb and page.json describe what this page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Edge cases relevant to this angle are exercised; the remaining corners live in sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level conformance.json (13 assertions): 13/13 pass on Chrome for Testing 160.0.8184.0 with the flag; on Chrome 158 only the optional-interpolation and out-of-range checks pass, as expected.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Exercised with Playwright on headless Chrome for Testing 160.0.8184.0 (flag) and Chrome 158 (no flag) at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800; zero page errors and no failed requests after the final edit. Not verified with chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable in the cloud routine, and not verified on Chrome 161.

telemetry_health.rationale: Calls showcaseTelemetry.support once from the exact-surface probe and asserts the primary contract on each interaction.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css for text and backgrounds; swatch colours are the demo output.

accessibility.rationale: Native inputs/selects/buttons with labels, 44px targets, role=status readouts, visible focus. Swatch colour is also given as text. The accessibility tree was not inspected (no DevTools MCP).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow and all controls usable at 360x740 and 1280x800 in both browsers.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on Chrome 161 with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Verified natively only on Chrome for Testing 160.0.8184.0 behind CSSColorMixVariadic. Re-run on a 161 build where the feature is on by default, and inspect the accessibility tree.

guidanceConsulted.query: mix several colors into a palette with css color-mix
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Default to in oklab when mixing; never use oklch when mixing with neutrals (powerless hue).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pages default to oklab where a space is not the subject of the test; order-and-hue documents the oklch neutral-hue behaviour with a measured value instead of recommending oklch for tints.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: color-mix(in oklch, blue, white, gray) kept hue 264.051 on Chrome for Testing 160.0.8184.0.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible labelled range slider controls with live output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native range inputs with visible labels; expose formatted values in DOM content and update aria-valuetext.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Range inputs are native, labelled, paired with <output for>, and update aria-valuetext ('33 percent' / 'omitted') on every input event.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: aria-valuetext observed updating in the Playwright run on percentage-normalization and single-colour-conversion.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min, 1fr)) grids and wrapping flex rows instead of fixed widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Swatch, canvas and percentage grids use auto-fit/minmax; control rows flex-wrap; long computed values use overflow-wrap:anywhere.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth = 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 on all 7 pages, Chrome 158 and Canary 160.

summary: New concept built by the daily routine on 2026-11-26 and tested natively behind the flag.
